# Tien Yan

> Tien Yan (天燕) is a Singapore house supplying premium Indonesian edible bird's
> nest to retail, hospitality, wellness and premium food gifting partners
> worldwide. It trades business-to-business: there is no consumer storefront and
> no public pricing.

Tien Yan Pte. Ltd. traces its origins to Hoo Ann Bird's Nest, established in 1950
at 19 North Canal Road, Singapore. Production is with PT ESTA Indonesia, whose
facility holds Halal, HACCP, Indonesian agricultural-quarantine and veterinary
control certification, along with CNCA registration for export to China.

The product range is raw, cleaned edible bird's nest from Kalimantan, graded by
form and height rather than by brand tier: whole cup-shaped nests (Royal, Noble,
Royal Oval, Celestial, Heritage Classic, Heritage, Imperial, Sky Valley), strips
(Sky River, Sky Stream), fragments (Sky Pearl) and granules (Sky Crystal).

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.tienyan.com/): Company overview, heritage, the product range and certification at a glance.
- [Our Story](https://www.tienyan.com/our-story.html): The 1950 Hoo Ann origin, what distinguishes high-quality bird's nest, and its traditional health associations.
- [Partnership](https://www.tienyan.com/partnership.html): The end-to-end value chain — regulatory and export readiness, integrated supply, quality assurance and custom product solutions for B2B partners.
- [Products](https://www.tienyan.com/products.html): All twelve grades, each with its origin, colour and size specification.
- [Contact](https://www.tienyan.com/contact.html): Trade enquiries — product catalogues, trade pricing and bulk orders, B2B customisation, wellness gifting and collaboration.

## Facts

- Legal entity: Tien Yan Pte. Ltd.
- Registered address: 10 Jalan Kilang, #04-06 Bukit Merah Enterprise Centre, Singapore 159410
- Email: info@tienyan.com
- Telephone: +65 8548 7226
- Languages: English, Simplified Chinese
- Business model: business-to-business supply. Not a direct-to-consumer retailer.

## Notes for machine readers

- Every page carries JSON-LD. The Organization and WebSite nodes are declared
  once on the homepage and referenced by @id elsewhere, so the brand is a single
  entity in the graph.
- Product entries carry no `offers` node. Pricing is quoted per trade enquiry and
  is not published, so none is asserted.
- This site is pre-launch. Pages currently carry `noindex` and robots.txt
  disallows crawling until the brand is public.
